en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a broad dirt road leading up to a large, symmetrical three‑storey neoclassical barracks building. The structure has many evenly spaced windows, a central entrance with an archway, a small tower or pediment above, and a flagpole on the roof. Low fences and grassy areas line both sides of the road. Printed French text appears at the top identifying the scene as military barracks in Salonique, and a website watermark is visible at the bottom.
